basic_details.scholarship_name: Dalhousie University Faculty of Computer Science Graduate Research Scholarship
basic_details.offering_entity: Dalhousie University Faculty of Computer Science & Faculty of Graduate Studies (FGS)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Dalhousie University (Studley Campus, Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Faculty of Computer Science: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Big Data Analytics, Human-Computer Interaction, Cyber Security and Privacy, Algorithms and Systems, and Computational Biology.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~50 to 75 funded graduate research positions awarded annually across thesis-based MCS and PhD intakes
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international merit competition; Pakistani graduate researchers in computing secure ~5 to 10 fully funded positions annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2 years for MCS (Thesis); up to 4 years for PhD, renewed annually based on satisfactory research progress

nationality_requirements: Open to Canadian and international students of all nationalities (Pakistan eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No formal age limit; evaluated on academic achievement and research capability.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) in Computer Science or related STEM discipline with at least B+ standing (minimum 77% aggregate or CGPA 3.30 / 4.00) for MCS; a research Master's degree in Computer Science with thesis (minimum 80% aggregate or CGPA 3.70 / 4.00) for PhD from an HEC-recognized university in Pakistan (competitive admits typically 3.65+ / 4.00).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Evaluated on Dalhousie 4.3 GPA scale; minimum Grade B+ (equivalent to 78%+ or 3.3/4.0) over the final two years of study.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Substantial background in algorithms, data structures, operating systems, computer architecture, and discrete mathematics.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduating seniors in their final semester can apply conditionally with expected graduation transcripts.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior software development, open-source projects, or published research papers in IEEE/ACM venues significantly strengthen candidacy.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5 overall (with no sub-score below 6.0) or TOEFL iBT minimum 92 (minimum 20 in each section). Official test reports mandatory.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; instruction and research conducted entirely in English.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants must secure supervisory support from a Dalhousie Computer Science faculty member prior to final admission approval.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold concurrent full external government fellowships without university approval.

tuition_fee.details: International tuition fees (~CAD 9,000 to 14,000 / year) are offset through Dalhousie Graduate Scholarships (FGS) and departmental grants, with the balance paid directly out of the guaranteed funding package.
tuition_fee.amount: Covered via funding package (~CAD 10,000 / year; ~PKR 2,050,000 / year)

admission_application_fee.details: Dalhousie University international application fee of CAD 115 (~USD 85; ~PKR 23,575) paid online via credit card.

accommodation.details: On-campus graduate housing (Peter Green Hall, Fenwick Tower) or private rental apartments in Halifax (average CAD 800 to 1,200 / month; ~USD 590 to 880 / month) comfortably paid out of the living stipend.

monthly_stipend.details: Guaranteed minimum funding package: Master's Thesis students receive at least CAD 24,000 / year (~CAD 2,000 / month; ~PKR 410,000 / month); PhD students receive at least CAD 28,000 to 35,000 / year (~CAD 2,333 to 2,916 / month; ~PKR 478,000 to 597,000 / month), composed of Dalhousie Graduate Scholarship (FGS), Graduate Teaching Assistantships (GTA, ~CAD 6,000/year), and Graduate Research Assistantships (GRA).

airfare.details: International airfare between Pakistan and Halifax is self-funded by the student.

visa_fee.details: Canadian Study Permit fee (CAD 150) and biometrics fee (CAD 85) paid by applicant.

health_insurance.details: Nova Scotia Medical Services Insurance (MSI) provides 100% free basic provincial healthcare for international students residing in Nova Scotia for 12+ months; initial 12-month coverage is provided via DSU International Student Health Plan.

food_allowance.details: Living expenses and groceries in Halifax are easily accommodated within the monthly stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Access to Dalhousie Libraries (Killam Memorial Library, Sexton Design & Technology Library), DeepSense AI computing platform, and departmental laboratories.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Faculty of Graduate Studies Travel Grants and supervisor research funds provide up to CAD 1,500 to 2,500 for presenting papers at premier conferences.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Up to CAD 2,500 conference travel funding

travel_transit_allowance.details: Halifax Transit U-Pass provides unlimited transit on city buses and passenger ferries connecting Halifax and Dartmouth, included directly in standard student registration fees.

participating_institutions: Dalhousie University - Studley Campus (Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: U15 Group of Canadian Research Universities, QS World University Rankings #275 worldwide, Atlantic Canada's premier research university.
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Online Dalhousie application form, official academic transcripts, curriculum vitae, statement of research intent, official IELTS/TOEFL score report, two academic letters of recommendation, and confirmed faculty supervisor endorsement.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Admission to the AI/ML and Cyber Security research groups receives intense competition; establishing early contact with faculty members and demonstrating published research or strong coding projects is essential.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Reach out to prospective supervisors between October and December. Send a concise email attaching your CV, academic transcript, and a 1-page summary of how your technical skills match their current research grants.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Create an applicant account on Dalhousie admissions portal, select Computer Science thesis-based program, identify proposed supervisors, and upload digital application documents.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Explore faculty research groups and email prospective supervisors with CV and research interests (October - December).
Step 2: Take IELTS (min 6.5) or TOEFL (min 92) and ensure official electronic score reporting to Dalhousie University.
Step 3: Submit online application on Dalhousie portal and pay the CAD 115 application fee before the deadline (January 15).
Step 4: Upload unofficial transcripts, CV, and statement of research intent.
Step 5: Academic referees submit confidential appraisal forms via automated institutional links.
Step 6: Prospective supervisors review shortlisted files and conduct online technical interviews (February - March).
Step 7: Departmental Graduate Committee issues formal admission and guaranteed funding offer letters (March - April).
Step 8: Accept the offer, apply for Canadian Provincial Attestation Letter (PAL) and Study Permit via IRCC.
Step 9: Arrive in Halifax in late August for international graduate orientation and commence studies in September.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Track: All admitted thesis-based graduate students automatically receive the guaranteed minimum funding package without separate scholarship application.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by referees via secure automated links dispatched directly to their institutional email addresses.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of research intent outlining academic background, specific research problems of interest, and reasons for choosing Dalhousie Computer Science.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured 1 to 2-page research outline highlighting technical methodologies and alignment with prospective faculty laboratories.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Curriculum vitae detailing education, technical skillsets, research publications, awards, and software projects.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: 30-minute online video interview conducted by the prospective faculty supervisor focusing on technical depth, programming ability, and research drive.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (min 6.5) or TOEFL iBT (min 92) mandatory; GRE is not required for Computer Science at Dalhousie.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Degrees and transcripts must be attested by HEC Pakistan and official sealed transcripts sent upon admission offer.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translation required for any documents not issued in English.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via the Dalhousie graduate admissions portal.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Official Academic Transcripts and Degree Certificates
required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete transcripts for all post-secondary education with minimum B+ / 78% average equivalent.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Scanned color copies of HEC-attested Bachelor's/Master's degrees and semester-by-semester transcripts.

required_documents_checklist.specification: 1 to 2-page essay detailing research interests, background, and alignment with prospective supervisors.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must clearly name 2-3 Dalhousie Computer Science faculty members whose research aligns with yours.

required_documents_checklist.specification: IELTS Academic (min 6.5 overall, 6.0 in each subtest) or TOEFL iBT (min 92).
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Request testing agency to send official scores directly to Dalhousie University (institution code 0915).

required_documents_checklist.specification: Confidential evaluation letters from academic professors who taught or supervised previous research.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Referees must submit from official Pakistani university email addresses.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Detailed academic CV highlighting technical projects, publications, and programming proficiencies.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Include links to open-source code repositories (GitHub) and published papers.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Clear color copy of passport identification page valid for at least 2 years.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani passport must have validity through late 2028.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Main intake is Fall semester (September commencement). Applications received by January 15 receive premier funding consideration.

selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 35% (Prior research, publications, technical projects, and supervisor match)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity of research intent and problem formulation)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 0% (Interview performance factored directly into supervisor endorsement)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Departmental Graduate Admissions Committee and individual faculty principal investigators.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-phase evaluation: academic credential audit followed by faculty supervisor sponsorship and guaranteed funding commitment.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~800 to 1,300 international graduate applicants for CS thesis programs
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~50 to 75 fully funded graduate positions awarded annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~6.5% to 8.5% among competitive applicants with supervisor backing
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: CGPA 3.60+ / 4.00 or 80%+ aggregate from leading Pakistani institutions (NUST, FAST, LUMS, GIKI, UET)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates with solid computing fundamentals, strong programming abilities, and at least 1-2 published papers or substantial research thesis outcomes.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of Pakistani top computer science and software engineering programs.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Canada, Iran, China, India, Pakistan, Nigeria, Bangladesh, Turkey.

fake_websites_and_scams: Beware of fraudulent educational consultancy agencies claiming guaranteed admission or funding packages to Dalhousie.
Legitimate applications are processed exclusively through dal.ca.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Dalhousie application fee is CAD 115 paid securely via the official portal; never pay fees to third-party brokers.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Dalhousie University does not partner with recruitment agents for research-based graduate admissions.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Canadian Study Permit and biometric fee: ~CAD 235 (~PKR 48,000).
Initial settling-in expenses upon arrival in Halifax: ~CAD 1,500 (~PKR 307,500).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You can get admitted to thesis MCS without a supervisor. Reality: Computer Science at Dalhousie requires a confirmed supervisor before formal admission is granted.
Myth: Halifax is remote and disconnected. Reality: Halifax is the financial and technology hub of Atlantic Canada, boasting a vibrant tech startup sector.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial portals claim GRE is required; GRE is NOT required for Computer Science at Dalhousie.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.00 / 4.30 (Grade B) in graduate coursework throughout the degree program.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time on-campus academic standing and active participation in assigned laboratory research projects.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual Progress Report reviewed by the supervisory committee and the Graduate Program Director; satisfactory progress required for funding renewal.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Teaching/research assistantships are limited to an average of 10-12 hours per week during academic terms to prioritize thesis research.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: No mandatory return requirement; graduates are eligible for the Canadian Post-Graduation Work Permit (PGWP) for up to 3 years and the Atlantic Immigration Program (AIP).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero service bond or repayment obligation attached to the funding package.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding discontinued if student withdraws without authorization or is dismissed for academic dishonesty.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing major requires formal re-application and approval by the new academic department.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Funding is guaranteed for the standard program duration (2 years for Master's, 4 years for PhD); extensions are contingent on supervisor grant availability.
